## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the IDEA/FEAT or decision when relevant.

## Validation

List checks actually run and their results. State what remains unverified.
For UI, include screenshots; for source/auth/data changes, cover the relevant failure and isolation paths.

## Risks and recovery

Describe material risks, migrations or configuration needs, and how to undo the change.

## Records

- [ ] Relevant acceptance criteria and implementation records match the work.
- [ ] RESUME and devlog capture current state and next steps.
- [ ] Diff reviewed for secrets, private family data and unrelated changes.
